title: Silent Film Projection — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The physical choice
scenes.purpose: A top-hatted lamplighter silhouette on a blue-tinted night street weighs a loose plug, winds back and thrusts it into the pole's junction box.
visuals: Wide stage framing: full figure, both hands, two poles and an unlit lamp string
Tinted night stock (#294359 / #111722) with dark film edges outside the gate
Pose motion sampled at 12 exposures per second

beats.development: Anticipation: he looks at the plug and draws his hand back while the sagging wire follows it.
The thrust: the arm reaches up to the box, the wire pulls taut and a small spark flashes on contact.

scenes.title: Intertitle
scenes.purpose: Hard cut to a bordered editorial card that names the idea.
visuals: Dark card with cream double border, corner diamonds and a teal active diamond
Large centred serif lines; scratches kept outside the lettering

beats.development: Card appears complete on the cut and holds for reading.

scenes.title: The whole street lights up
scenes.purpose: Cut back on the immediate consequence: the system connects and lights up.
visuals: Bulbs light one by one from the plug back to the far pole
House windows across the street light up
Lamplighter steps back with arms open

beats.development: Lamp cascade, windows switching on and the figure's reaction.
Settled lit street held as the result.

findings: Action, card and consequence each take about a third of the reel; the motion is complete by 2.6 s.
justifiedHolds: 1.0 s intertitle hold for the five-word line
0.4 s held final lit street as the payoff

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
